hints: Resolve all four coplanar forces horizontally and set the sum to zero: $P\cos 25^\circ = 22 + 16\cos 55^\circ$.
Solve this horizontal equation directly to determine the magnitude of $P$.
Resolve all four forces vertically: $Q + 16\sin 55^\circ = P\sin 25^\circ$, substitute the value of $P$, and solve for $Q$.
walkthrough:
Resolve forces horizontally in equilibrium (taking rightwards as positive):
$$P\cos 25^\circ - 22 - 16\cos 55^\circ = 0$$
$$P\cos 25^\circ = 22 + 16\cos 55^\circ \approx 22 + 9.1772 = 31.1772\text{ N}$$

Resolve forces vertically in equilibrium (taking upwards as positive):
$$P\sin 25^\circ - Q - 16\sin 55^\circ = 0$$
$$Q = P\sin 25^\circ - 16\sin 55^\circ$$
$$Q \approx 34.4003(0.422618) - 16(0.819152) \approx 14.5382 - 13.1064 = 1.43\text{ N}$$

ai_rubric.Applying Coplanar Equilibrium: Resolves horizontally to get $P\cos 25^\circ = 22 + 16\cos 55^\circ \implies P = 34.4\text{ N}$, and vertically to obtain $Q = 1.43\text{ N}$.

teacher_walkthrough:
State the equilibrium conditions for a system of coplanar forces:
$$\sum F_x = 0\quad\text{and}\quad\sum F_y = 0$$

Set up the horizontal equilibrium equation (taking rightwards as positive):
- Component of force $P$: $+P\cos 25^\circ$
- $22\text{ N}$ force: directed horizontally to the left, component $-22$
- $16\text{ N}$ force: at $55^\circ$ below the negative horizontal axis, horizontal component $-16\cos 55^\circ$
- Force $Q$: directed vertically downwards, horizontal component $0$
Equating horizontal components to zero:
$$P\cos 25^\circ - 22 - 16\cos 55^\circ = 0$$
$$P\cos 25^\circ = 22 + 16\cos 55^\circ$$
Calculate the cosine values:
$$\cos 55^\circ \approx 0.573576$$
$$16\cos 55^\circ \approx 16 \times 0.573576 = 9.17722\text{ N}$$
$$P\cos 25^\circ = 22 + 9.17722 = 31.17722\text{ N}$$
Divide by $\cos 25^\circ \approx 0.906308$:
$$P = \frac{31.17722}{0.906308} \approx 34.4003\text{ N}$$
Rounding to 3 significant figures gives $P = 34.4\text{ N}$.

Set up the vertical equilibrium equation (taking upwards as positive):
- Component of force $P$: $+P\sin 25^\circ$
- $22\text{ N}$ force: vertical component $0$
- $16\text{ N}$ force: vertical component $-16\sin 55^\circ$
- Force $Q$: vertical component $-Q$
Equating vertical components to zero:
$$P\sin 25^\circ - Q - 16\sin 55^\circ = 0$$
Rearrange to make $Q$ the subject:
$$Q = P\sin 25^\circ - 16\sin 55^\circ$$
Substitute $P = 34.4003$ and the sine values:
$$\sin 25^\circ \approx 0.422618$$
$$\sin 55^\circ \approx 0.819152$$
$$P\sin 25^\circ \approx 34.4003 \times 0.422618 = 14.5382\text{ N}$$
$$16\sin 55^\circ \approx 16 \times 0.819152 = 13.1064\text{ N}$$
$$Q = 14.5382 - 13.1064 = 1.4318\text{ N}$$
Rounding to 3 significant figures gives $Q = 1.43\text{ N}$.
